title: OpenSpec UI Agentic Harness — global config
description: Global default for openspec/agent-harness.json — see the agentic-harness capability. reviewGate.mode is fixed to human-required at this level; only a per-change openspec/changes/<id>/harness.json may set agent-sufficient.

autonomyLevel.description: semi-autonomous and autonomous are accepted and persisted but not yet functional — see openspec/changes/agentic-harness/design.md.

mode.description: agent-sufficient is only valid in a per-change harness.json, never here.

agentId.description: Must match an AgentDescriptor.id from packages/core/src/agents/registry.ts — kept in sync by hand (a small, stable list).
